text.title: Mire Convoy
text.body: Quartermaster Bram leads our last powder pack along the sunken causeway toward the north-east ridge depot. Keep him alive through the bog trails and break the blockade guarding the depot gate.
text.obj.0: Escort Quartermaster Bram and your hero to the ridge depot
text.msg.1: Stay on the firm dirt track where you can, and keep me behind your shields.
text.msg.2: Bog lurkers rising on both flanks of the causeway!
text.msg.3: The ridge blockade is shattered; pry loose the iron-reinforced payroll coffer abandoned in their baggage train.
text.msg.4: We reached the depot gate with every powder keg dry!
text.win: The convoy reaches the ridge depot intact.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen in the mire.
text.fail.2: Quartermaster Bram has fallen; the convoy is lost in the bog.
